text: This solution, Nationally Determined Contribution Information Management System Upgrade (NDC‑IMS upgrade) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Papua New Guinea between Climate Change and Development Authority (CCDA), Regional Pacific NDC Hub, GIZ, Pacific Community (SPC), and UNDP Climate Promise. The program was implemented in 2021 and focuses on collaboration and raising awareness.
